concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but writes to shared artifacts (`config.py`, `requirements.txt`, `data/raw/checksums.json`). Subsequent tasks T014, T015, and T002 also modify `checksums.json`, creating a race condition if run in parallel. The `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.

Task T014 is marked `[P]` yet updates `data/raw/checksums.json` and creates `data/external/acquisition_log.json`. These files are also written by T001 and T015, so parallel execution could corrupt the checksum registry. The `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T015 is marked `[P]` but appends to `data/raw/checksums.json` after generating the synthetic dataset. Because T001 and T014 also write to the same JSON, parallel runs would conflict. The `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T002 is marked `[P]` yet writes multiple downstream artifacts (`data/processed/unified_fatigue.csv`, `data/processed/missing_flags.json`, `logs/proxy_clamp.log`) and reads/writes `data/raw/checksums.json`. Running it in parallel with any of T001, T014, T015 could cause inconsistent checksums or partial outputs. The `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T003 is marked `[P]` but creates/updates `data/results/runtime_summary.csv` and orchestrates the whole pipeline. If executed concurrently with other `[P]` tasks that also write runtime logs (e.g., T001‑T002), file‑write races will occur. The `[P]` tag is unsafe.
